notes: ① 插件更新拆成两步：点「下载更新」只把包下到 ~\.dsh\update-staging\ 并校验 sha256，插件目录一个字节都不改 —— 正在看的「配置同步」页面不会再在更新途中跳走；下载完按钮换成「重启并安装」，点它才退出，由退出后的脚本覆盖安装并自动拉起新版本，全程只重启一次。② 退出后的安装现在能直接用宿主下好的本地包，不再重复下载（写坏照样用备份回滚）。③ 老的运行中静默安装（install-live）保留给 CLI/脚本，界面不再使用。
notesEn: (1) The update is split into two steps: "Download" only drops the package into ~\.dsh\update-staging\ and verifies its sha256 — the plugin directory is left untouched, so the Config Sync page you are looking at never jumps away mid-update. The button then becomes "Restart & install": that one exits DSH, and the post-exit script installs the package and relaunches the new version, so exactly one restart is needed. (2) The post-exit install now uses the package the host already downloaded instead of fetching it again (a failed write still rolls back from the backup). (3) The legacy live install (install-live) stays available for CLI/scripts; the panel no longer uses it.
